versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-rednote-lens.

- Fetches structured data from Xiaohongshu (Redbook): keyword search, note details, comments, and blogger posts, up to 10,000 items per request.
- Designed for content gathering, comparison, and reporting—supports scenario-specific workflows (topic research, opinion analysis, competitor monitoring).
- Requires only public data, no interaction or private content access.
- All commands require a valid GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN.
- Outputs consistent, structured JSON; robust error handling and execution safeguards included.
